species.name: Honeybee
species.niche: Daylight insect · UV, blue and green pathways
species.selection: Reference receptor curves and functional opsin evidence provide a transparent spectral test case. No matched bee behavioral dataset is scored in this release.

chain.label: Sensory gene
chain.title: Three visual opsin reference records
chain.text: UV AMUVOP, blue AMBLOP and long-wavelength opsin records retain their annotated coding sequences. These records are not from the bees in the camera benchmark.
chain.gap: Genotype and expression are not jointly measured in the benchmark animals.

chain.label: Expressed protein
chain.title: Functional opsins, not an abundance map
chain.text: Published blue and UV opsins were functionally expressed in Drosophila photoreceptors. Deposited translations identify the protein sequences; they do not quantify protein abundance in a honeybee eye.
chain.gap: No matched endogenous protein concentration or chromophore measurements.

chain.label: Sensory tissue
chain.title: Compound-eye photoreceptor pathways
chain.text: The pilot uses the UV, blue and green curves provided with the animal-view imaging dataset. Eye geometry, retinal position, adaptation and neural processing are not modeled.
chain.gap: No independent ocular-filter ablation or regional expression measurements.

chain.label: Stimulus
chain.title: A laboratory spectrum probe
chain.text: 76 clownfish-study LED targets probe the reference bee curves. The same held-out color families test every model. These are not recorded honeybee habitats.
chain.gap: Natural illumination and surface-reflectance generalization remain untested.

chain.label: Measured response
chain.title: Functional response linked; behavior unscored
chain.text: The molecular paper reports functional light responses. Here, phone-model outputs predict sensitivity-weighted scores only. No honeybee choices, neural recordings or subjective colors were measured for these targets.
chain.gap: A future bee behavior cohort is required for a complete stimulus-to-choice test.

species.name: Fruit fly
species.niche: Compound eye · opsins plus screening pigments
species.selection: Single-opsin rescue experiments expose why sequence or isolated pigment sensitivity alone can miss whole-eye filtering. The separate FlyBody specimen and neural-resource section now link this reference study to anatomical inspection; the source specimens are not experimentally matched.

chain.label: Sensory gene
chain.title: Rh3, Rh4, Rh5, ninaE/Rh1 and Rh6
chain.text: Five reference protein sequences are linked by gene name. Nucleotide sequences were not imported for the fly; the viewer does not fabricate an ATCG sequence from protein.
chain.gap: No allele-matched DNA, transcript and assay cohort.

chain.label: Expressed protein
chain.title: Opsin-specific rescue provides functional evidence
chain.text: The source study isolates opsin contributions in rescue backgrounds. These engineered assays must remain distinct from normal whole-animal vision and quantitative pigment abundance.
chain.gap: Protein amounts and chromophore occupancy are not measured in this benchmark.

chain.label: Sensory tissue
chain.title: Receptors act within an optically filtering eye
chain.text: Rh1 is associated with outer R1–R6 cells; Rh3/Rh4 with R7 subtypes and Rh5/Rh6 with R8 subtypes. Screening and filtering pigments alter effective sensitivity. Only Rh3/Rh4/Rh5 short-range ERG means are used here.
chain.gap: This is not a full ommatidial, spatial, polarization or motion model.

chain.label: Stimulus
chain.title: 315–550 nm assay window
chain.evidence: Published mean ERG curves + computational LED probe
chain.text: The normalized mean ERG weights use the published short-range measurements. Longer Rh1/Rh6 series were not stitched to the short series because their overlapping amplitudes differ.
chain.gap: No inference beyond the assay window; ERG voltage is not a calibrated quantum-efficiency curve.

chain.label: Measured response
chain.title: ERG physiology and a separate behavior study
chain.evidence: Measured ERG; behavior source linked, not reanalyzed
chain.text: The benchmark predicts ERG-weighted proxy scores. An independent study links spectral pathways to responses to approaching objects, but those trials are not included in these held-out results.
chain.gap: No demonstrated mapping from these phone scores to natural fly decisions.

species.name: Clown anemonefish
species.selection: Open retinal-expression evidence, lens measurements, spectral targets and individual choice trials support separate molecular and behavioral checks.

chain.label: Sensory gene
chain.title: An opsin repertoire with duplicated genes
chain.text: SWS1α/β, SWS2B, RH2A1/A2, RH2B, LWS and RH1 are linked to deposited coding sequences. Introns are preserved in the reference record; spliced CDS and annotated proteins are separately inspectable.
chain.gap: The references are not genotypes from the behavioral fish.

chain.label: Expressed protein
chain.title: RNA supports expression; protein abundance is unresolved
chain.text: The 2021 retinal dataset detected six cone opsins and RH1, with co-expression in some cones. SWS1α was not detected in that dataset. RNA localization is not a measurement of protein concentration.
chain.gap: Do not treat an undetected transcript as universal gene absence, or one gene as one receptor class.

chain.label: Sensory tissue
chain.title: Cone pigment templates × measured lens transmission
chain.text: The pilot combines the published four cone templates with mean transmission from three lenses. Templates represent fitted pigment sensitivity, including the source's chromophore assumptions. Co-expression is not independently fitted here.
chain.gap: These optics and expression measurements come from different specimens/studies.

chain.label: Stimulus
chain.title: 76 measured LED targets in nine color families
chain.text: Targets and a grey background were measured in the source experiment. Grey is excluded from scoring. Whole color families are held out, preventing intensity variants from appearing on both sides of a split.
chain.gap: Lab radiance is not reef illumination. Multiplying it by a habitat illuminant would double count the illumination.

chain.label: Measured response
chain.title: 4,411 trial outcomes from 11 female fish
chain.text: There are 3,921 nonzero-contrast trials and 490 zero-contrast controls. One fish is held out at a time. Models compare training prevalence, published biological contrast (JND), and contrast plus the published UV-condition label. These are behavioral predictions, separate from the spectral phone benchmark.
chain.gap: Condition is confounded with color and experimental history. This is neither a causal UV test nor a sequence-only baseline.
